newsitem.title: USA: Nov cash flow to US stock funds $15.5 bln - ICI.
newsitem.headline: Nov cash flow to US stock funds $15.5 bln - ICI.

text.p: Net new cash flows into U.S. stock mutual funds rose to an estimated $15.5 billion in November from $13.47 billion in October, according to a preliminary estimate issued by an industry trade group on Wednesday.
Investment Company Institute chief economist John Rea noted that although the inflow to equity funds came amid a surge in stock prices, it remained within the range in place since mid-1996.

"Relative to the gains recorded in stock prices, the inflow into equity funds was not outsized," Rea said in a statement. "The estimated inflow in November is well below the average monthly inflow of $24.7 billion over the first five months of the year."
Bond and income funds had an estimated inflow of $2.0 billion in November, compared with an outflow of $0.38 billion in October.
The ICI said its monthly estimates are derived from weekly estimates based on a survey of long-term funds that account for about 97 percent of long-term mutual fund assets.
Actual data for November will be reported in two to three weeks.
